test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
The following pie chart shows the share of the marks scored by Rahul in an examination in each of 5 different subjects -English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science and Social Science — as percentages of the total marks scored by Rahul in all the 5 subjects taken together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8327baff8a8ac29852b046c009a6a0abbe15d5e6f725c76a6a45dab4bd884166.png] 

What is the central angle showing the shares of the marks in Hindi and Social Science, taken together?
solution:
**Given:**

Marks scored by Rahul in 5 different subjects

Pie-chart shows percentage of marks in all the 5 subjects

**Concept used:**

100% represents 360^circ 

**Calculation:**

Percentage of Hindi given in pie-chart = 24%

Percentage of Social Science given = 16%

As, 100% = 360^circ

⇒ 24% = (360/100) × 24 = 86.4^circ

⇒ central angle of Hindi = 86.4^circ

⇒ 16% = (360/100) × 16 = 57.6^circ

⇒ central angle of Social science = 57.6^circ 

⇒ Central angle of Hindi and Social science taken together = ( 86.4^circ + 57.6^circ) = 144^circ

**Hence, Central angle of Hindi and Social Science is 144^circ****.**
